summary: Pin is in planted botanic garden beds on a steep slope; no vehicle access.
reasons: Foot paths and garden beds only

drivers.seclusion: Dense garden planting, but visitor buildings and paths within 60-90 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Only narrow footpaths reach the pin; no tyre tracks or vehicles. Nearest road is the garden's asphalt road about 55 m north, with no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Visitor centre, planetarium and car park close by; busy by day.
drivers.convention: Botanic garden; no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Garden gates mapped 117-185 m away, not on the only access
Pin is in managed gardens, near a creek (27 m)
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy all round; mostly shaded.
cannot_judge: Opening hours and closure of the garden roads
